cohort: 64 HIV-infected women and 128 HIV-negative women who had a PPIUD inserted at the University Hospital of Treichville between January 2016 and March 2017
finding: HIV infection was not significantly associated with an increased risk of PPIUD complications.
mod_finding: This study found that HIV infection does not increase the risk of complications from immediate postpartum intrauterine device (PPIUD) insertion.
